# Altairith Capital

> Private, long-horizon holding company. We build, invest in and hold companies, and reinvest their profits into financial assets and licensable intellectual property. Founded by security researcher and inventor Christian Vari.

Altairith Capital (Altairith Capital Holding S.r.l.) is a private, long-horizon holding company whose group companies are active in areas including Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Web3 & Blockchain, Fintech. Founded in 2025 and chaired by Christian Vari. Tagline: "Lead from Above. Build to Endure."
